'''Amick Mudd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He guarded a concealed staircase that lead into the depths of the station and when the [[Heroes of Cularin]] entered the engineering section of the station while in pursuit of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]], Mudd let them have access to the staircase after they stated the staircase's password.
